blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse — contracts, streaming, and the decisions a lakehouse is actually for.

Nobody buys a lakehouse; they buy decisions they can defend. Data contracts turn reliability into a property instead of a promise, and streaming is a business decision wearing a technology costume — the theses below take both seriously.
Argued from estates we migrated and operate, with the reconciliation deltas to show for it.
